messages:
Anya: quick sync - sketching a small design for a "transient-claim" sidecar to reduce hot-path fanout. want quick takes.
Omar: high level ok. is claim used only for routing or for final billing?
Anya: routing-first. reconciler will emit settled attribution to canonical stream. claims are advisory to avoid duplicate work.
Jing: advisory is safer. but audits need both claim stream + reconciler decisions to reconstruct billing.
Devin: agree. two options: INLINE claim fields in event vs SIDELOAD small claim messages. SIDELOAD reduces bytes but needs a join.
Leo: infra note: joins add tail latency. what join window are we comfortable with? 250ms for PLG, 2s for enterprise?
Anya: propose tenant-profile defaults: INLINE for <100 qps, SIDELOAD for high-qps. join window configurable per-tenant.
Omar: how do we dedupe claim updates if clients spam retries? can checkpointing help?
Jing: yes - compact claims into per-req checkpoints every N minutes and keep raw tail for N_tail. reconciler can use checkpoint + tail.
Devin: scoring for reconciler: combine provenance hints (cache_hit, prefix_cached), claim_freshness, and source_reliability. include reason fields in settled event.
Anya: sample SIDELOAD claim (compact):
```
{
  "req_fp":"fp:v1:abcd",
  "claim_id":"c-4319994321-1",
  "src":"sdk",
  "hints":["prefix_cached"],
  "expires_ts":4319994600
}
```
Leo: small nit - salt the fingerprint per-workspace to avoid cross-tenant correlation.
Omar: UX: surface both initial claim attribution and settled attribution in debug logs. invoices use settled.
Jing: also add a resolution endpoint to return timeline of claim updates + settled decision for up to 90 days. helpful for support.
Devin: rollout plan: emit SIDELOAD topic behind FF, run reconciler dry-run comparing settled vs ledger for canaries, add chaos tests for out-of-order claims.
Anya: ops: storage policy idea: raw claim tail 3 days, checkpoints 1 year. reconciler rebuild guarantee: checkpoints + 3d tail. document rebuild window.
metering-bot: draft RFC uploaded: https://go/repo/transient-claim-sidecar (comments open) :eyes:
Devin: will review. thanks Anya. :thumbsup:
